I’m not ready to accept yet because I found two mismatches with the behaviour we approved:

- If I preserve a bookmark only through the Internet Archive, its archive link should appear on the card even when there is no local saved copy—or after the local copy is removed. The two options need to remain fully independent.
- After using bulk “Add tag,” the confirmation incorrectly says the bookmarks were untagged. It should confirm they were tagged; only “Remove tag” should report that they were untagged.

Please correct those two implementation issues and present the application again.
